scope: One customer_withholding fact references exactly one actual sales_invoice_cash_allocation targeting one sales_invoice_issue; a unique index allows at most one fact per allocation.
The fact amount is explicit, positive, currency-precision exact, and effective no earlier than the invoice issue or allocation and within the selected immutable account-scoped policy version.
The fact reduces customer receivable/net and sales invoice outstanding by its amount and adds the same amount as receivable/net to the policy-selected tax claim account.
The fact creates no treasury movement and no cash-in allocation capacity membership; actual cash remains the cash_in and ordinary sales_invoice_cash_allocation.
The selected tax claim account may differ from an invoice-time tax payable account; it must match the invoice entity/currency and have a tax_account opponent.
The path is separate from purchase receipt recognized_credit and adds no sales_invoice_tax_component.

mechanism.policy_version: Immutable READONLY tax_claim_account, policy_key, version, valid_from and valid_until fields; unique identity is (tax_claim_account, policy_key, version).
mechanism.withholding_fact: A user-managed fact has typed REJECT references to the actual allocation and selected policy. Derived issue, invoice, customer, tax account and date fields declare direct one-hop @rebase-depends edges.
mechanism.effects: At effective_at the fact posts customer receivable -amount/net -amount, sales_invoice outstanding -amount and selected tax claim receivable +amount/net +amount.
mechanism.capacity: Ordinary cash allocation contributes 90 to cash_in.z_allocations and reduces customer/invoice by 90. The distinct withholding fact relies on the shared customer claim and invoice outstanding floors for remaining settlement capacity; it does not add to the cash source pool.
mechanism.invoice_tax_control: The fixture includes one explicit invoice-time sales_invoice_tax_component with fixture-only key tcs_fixture_only. It continues posting its customer/invoice amount and one tax payable; the withholding fact posts only a distinct tax receivable. The fixture key carries no legal meaning.

probe.output: Accounting H4b4b customer-withheld TDS, allocation-linked claims, rollback, and cash/stock isolation passed
checks: A 90 base line plus one entered 10 invoice-time tax component opens customer receivable and invoice outstanding 100; exactly one managed sales_invoice_tax_component posts tax payable 10.
Actual cash_in and allocation of 90 leave customer receivable and invoice outstanding 10, treasury +90, and 90 allocated in the cash-in source pool.

Explicit withholding of 10 clears the remaining customer receivable and invoice outstanding, records tax-account receivable 10, leaves invoice tax payable exactly 10 once, and leaves treasury +90 and cash allocation capacity 90.
Independent row reconstruction checks customer receivable, invoice outstanding, invoice tax payable, withholding tax receivable, cash, source allocation capacity, and stock.

Zero, excess precision, duplicate allocation fact, amount 11 over-clear, wrong source type, invalid source party/entity/currency, mismatched policy entity/currency, policy with non-tax opponent, expired policy, and pre-invoice/allocation date reject with exact source, policy, output, cash, stock and root snapshots unchanged.
Mutation of selected immutable policy version rejects. Moving allocation or invoice issue date past the existing fact date rejects and rolls back the parent/source graph.

Failed amount edit over-clears and rolls back; valid amount edit preserves fact ID; removal and re-addition at the same ID update/restore claims while treasury, cash allocation pool, stock and invoice-time tax component remain unchanged.
Deleting the allocation while the fact exists rejects, so cleanup cannot strand the withholding fact.

limits: The amount is explicitly entered and policy-versioned; there is no formula, statutory interpretation, legal eligibility claim, or inferred withholding rate.
This is one current withholding fact per cash allocation; staged TDS, reversals, multiple withholding reasons per allocation, and remittance are later work.
The invoice-time tax row is a fixture-only entered component used to prove it remains exactly once; no TCS timing or legal semantics are claimed.
H4b4a payer-side supplier withholding is preserved as a separate account-scoped recipe and passed its regression probe.
